verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official MCP server that lets coding agents read review findings/codebase context, request PR reviews, triage issues, and even manage subscription/seats without leaving the MCP client, with a dedicated docs page (cubic-probe-4) and integration guidance across Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server works reliably in practice beyond first-party docs.
